slides.title: One deck, many looks
slides.body:
The same five slides, in every theme of the SlAIdy library.

**SlAIdy** · [kordikp.github.io/slaidy](https://kordikp.github.io/slaidy/)

slides.title: What a theme changes
slides.body:
A theme is a brand's look for the slides, and only for the slides.

- **Fonts** for the titles and the text
- **Colours**: the slide, the text, the accent
- **The cover and the closing**, the header and the footer

Your words, figures and markdown stay as they are.

> Switch the theme and the deck changes its clothes, not its content.

slides.title: From your text to the room
slides.body:
![[fig-theme-flow]]

> The theme sits between what you wrote and what the room sees.

slides.title: Add your own
slides.body:
| | |
|---|---|
| **1** | Fork `kordikp/slaidy` |
| **2** | Make `themes/<name>/`: `theme.css`, `theme.json`, the fonts with their licence, a logo |
| **3** | Run `python3 scripts/themes.py` and open this deck in your theme |
| **4** | Open a pull request: the suite checks it, the gallery shows it |

slides.title: Make it yours
slides.body:
Every theme: **[kordikp.github.io/slaidy/themes](https://kordikp.github.io/slaidy/themes/)**
